changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as the paper focuses on question answering, not dialogue. Removed redundant output description. Normalized task name.
Removed duplicate 'accuracy' entry and normalized metric names to standard forms.
Changed answer from 'No' to 'Yes' because GPT-4o is explicitly used to extract answers from SLM responses when string matching fails (Table 8 and Appendix G). Added proper description of the method.
No human evaluation was conducted - all evaluation is automated using ASR and string matching/LLM extraction.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating spoken language models through automated metrics. The extraction was mostly accurate but missed that GPT-4o was used as an evaluator (LLM-as-judge) for answer extraction in certain cases. The paper evaluates speech generation capabilities but focuses on knowledge understanding rather than pure NLG quality.
